title: Transpera process file (transpera-process/1)
description: A process for Transpera Flow: its steps and how they connect. Only the fields marked required have to be there; anything left out is filled in and marked to confirm on the canvas.

name.description: What the process is called, e.g. Enquiry to signed client.

kind.description: pipeline: how new leads become clients (default). servicing: a recurring process for existing clients.

description.description: A sentence on what the process covers.

entity_name.description: What flows through it, e.g. lead, task. Default: lead for a pipeline, item for a servicing process.

steps.description: Every step. Give each a short unique id that links refer to.

id.description: A short unique id, e.g. review. Links use it.

name.description: What the step is called on the map.

type.description: step: someone does work. decision: items branch. wait: items sit and wait. start and end: where items come in and finish.

role.description: The role that does it, e.g. Managing director. Roles the company doesn't have yet are matched in the preview; none are created.

person.description: A person to pin it to (only if they are already in the company; otherwise ignored).

hands_on_hours.description: Hours of hands-on work per item (average).

wait_hours.description: Hours an item waits at this step per item (average).

rework_rate.description: Share of items sent back to do again, from 0 to 1 (0.1 is one in ten).

x.description: Position on the map. Give x and y together, or leave both out to be laid out left to right.

links.description: How the steps connect, each from one step id to another.

probability.description: The share of items that take this branch, from 0 to 1. Branches out of a step add up to 1.

groups.description: Optional boxes that gather steps on the map.

steps.description: Ids of the steps in the group (not start or end steps).
